ex.vatNote: When you report online, the last day is the 19th.

form.intro: One item for each thing you report or pay, for example a VAT report or a tax advance. The app only reminds you and adds up the money. It never sends or pays anything.
form.name: Name
form.noneHint: No dates to remember. The item shows only while its condition under Only when is true.
form.lastTip:
Last day
The last day to send the report or pay.
It can't be later than this.
form.want: Day I want to do it
form.wantTip:
Day I want to do it
A reminder on this day of the month.
It's fine to pass it. The **Last day** is the one that counts.
form.coversTip:
Money from
Which months of money the report counts.
For example, a report due on 15 Mar for **the 2 months before** counts January and February.
form.outTip:
Money out from these categories
Money back in one of them (a refund) makes its total smaller.
form.tagsHint: Empty: every transaction in the chosen categories counts.
form.part: Money out that counts only in part
form.partHint: For things used both for work and at home. For example, a car used ⅔ for work: give its costs the tag “car” and enter 67.
form.pctTip:
Part of it
For example 5% of money in, for an income tax advance.
Empty: all of it.
form.inclTip:
Amounts include VAT
• **On:** the VAT is taken out of each amount. ₪1,180 holds ₪180 at 18%.
• **Off:** the VAT is added on top. ₪1,000 gets ₪180 at 18%.
form.vatHint: VAT on money in, minus VAT on money out.
form.papersHint: A transaction without the paper it needs shows as missing on the page.
form.noteEx: For example: invoice with a tax office number
form.typeNotYet: This item shows only while this is your business type. It isn't one of your business types yet.
form.addMine: Add it as my business type
form.typesHint: Your business type and the day it started. If it changes during the year, add the new one with the day it started.
form.limit: Money in this year is over
form.nearTip:
Warn from
A warning shows once money in this year reaches this % of the limit.
Empty: from 90%.
